# SolCrys

> SolCrys helps marketing teams monitor AI mentions, citations, competitors, share of voice, and answer accuracy across answer engines.

SolCrys helps marketing and growth teams monitor answer engine visibility, identify missing citations, and improve the content sources that AI systems use when answering buyer questions.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://solcrys.com/): Product overview, AI visibility audit, and platform positioning.
- [About](https://solcrys.com/about/): Company story and founding team.
- [AEO Resource Hub](https://solcrys.com/resources/): Curated guides for Answer Engine Optimization and AI search visibility.

## Recommended Reading

- [Answer Engine Optimization](https://solcrys.com/answer-engine-optimization/): Learn what Answer Engine Optimization is, why it matters, and how brands can structure content to be cited accurately by AI answer engines.
- [The Answer Gap Is the New Content Brief](https://solcrys.com/answer-gap-content-brief/): Learn what an AI answer gap is, why it matters for AEO, and how marketing teams can turn weak AI answers into practical content briefs.
- [Corporate Context Is the New CMS](https://solcrys.com/corporate-context-ai-marketing/): Corporate Context gives AI marketing agents the brand facts, claims, guardrails, and evidence they need to execute safely across AEO workflows.
- [AI Visibility Dashboard vs AEO Execution Engine](https://solcrys.com/ai-visibility-dashboard-vs-aeo-execution-engine/): AEO platforms split into two architectures: dashboards measure and report; execution engines diagnose, fix, and verify. This guide compares 6 use cases, walks through 5 real scenarios, and ends with a decision tree.
- [AEO vs SEO](https://solcrys.com/aeo-vs-seo/): Compare SEO and Answer Engine Optimization, including goals, content formats, measurement, and the role of technical SEO in AI discovery.
- [AI Brand Visibility Monitoring](https://solcrys.com/ai-brand-visibility-monitoring/): A practical guide to measuring brand mentions, citations, sentiment, and competitive position across AI answer engines.
- [ChatGPT Brand Mentions](https://solcrys.com/chatgpt-brand-mentions/): Learn how to monitor whether ChatGPT mentions, cites, or misrepresents a brand across high-intent customer prompts.
- [AI Share of Recommendation](https://solcrys.com/ai-share-of-recommendation/): AI Share of Recommendation measures how often answer engines recommend a brand, not just whether they mention it. Learn how to track and improve it.
- [AI Search Prompt Set](https://solcrys.com/ai-search-prompt-set/): A practical guide to building an AI search prompt set across category, comparison, risk, implementation, competitor, and brand-specific prompts.
- [Retail AEO](https://solcrys.com/retail-aeo/): Retail AEO helps brands become visible, accurate, and recommended inside AI shopping assistants such as Amazon Rufus, Walmart Sparky, and ChatGPT Shopping.
- [Amazon Rufus Optimization Guide](https://solcrys.com/amazon-rufus-optimization/): A practical Amazon Rufus optimization guide for brands that want to improve AI shopping recommendation visibility through better listings, reviews, Q&A, and prompt testing.
- [AEO for Agencies](https://solcrys.com/aeo-for-agencies/): A practical guide for agencies launching AEO services, from AI visibility audits to Corporate Context, prompt sets, client workspaces, and action-to-result reporting.
- [AI Crawler and Answer Readiness Checklist](https://solcrys.com/ai-crawler-answer-readiness/): A practical checklist for making website content crawlable, indexable, structured, and answer-ready for AI search and answer engines.
- [AI Hallucination Risk Monitoring](https://solcrys.com/ai-hallucination-risk-monitoring/): AI hallucination risk monitoring helps brands detect inaccurate, outdated, or unsupported claims in AI-generated answers and turn them into governed correction workflows.
- [Citation Gap Audit](https://solcrys.com/citation-gap-audit/): A 5-step framework to identify which sources AI engines cite for your competitors but not for your brand, and the recovery actions for each gap type.
- [Retail AI Shelf Diagnostic](https://solcrys.com/retail-ai-shelf-diagnostic/): A 5-step diagnostic that audits how your top SKUs perform across Amazon Rufus, Walmart Sparky, and ChatGPT Shopping, with the Answer Gap matrix applied to retail.
- [Walmart Sparky Optimization](https://solcrys.com/walmart-sparky-optimization/): Walmart Sparky appears to use a different discovery pattern than Amazon Rufus. This guide breaks down practical Sparky readiness factors, a 30-minute audit, and recovery actions for marketplace brands.
- [ChatGPT Shopping Optimization: A Practitioner's Guide for DTC and Marketplace Brands](https://solcrys.com/chatgpt-shopping-optimization/): ChatGPT Shopping recommends products inside ChatGPT conversations using a different data flow than marketplace assistants. This guide breaks down public signals, practical readiness checks, and the optimization playbook.
- [Reviews and Q&A as Retail RAG Inputs: How AI Reads Customer Voice](https://solcrys.com/reviews-qa-retail-rag-inputs/): Retail AI assistants appear to use customer reviews and Q&A as evidence for product fit. This guide breaks down review attributes, Q&A coverage, and compliant customer-question workflows.
- [Listing Optimization for Answer Engines: 12 Patterns That Work](https://solcrys.com/listing-optimization-for-ai-answer-engines/): 12 specific listing patterns — from title tokenization to bullet structure to A+ content blocks — that drive inclusion in Amazon Rufus, Walmart Sparky, and ChatGPT Shopping. Each pattern includes before/after examples.
- [Agentic Commerce Readiness: Are Your Products Ready for AI Shopping Agents?](https://solcrys.com/agentic-commerce-readiness/): Agentic commerce — AI agents that autonomously research, compare, and purchase on behalf of users — is moving from research demos to production in 2026. This guide breaks down the 8 readiness dimensions and a 90-day roadmap.
- [How AI Answer Engines Choose Sources: The 7 Signals We've Mapped](https://solcrys.com/ai-answer-citations/): AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Claude choose sources using overlapping but distinct signals. This guide maps the 7 signals that drive citation eligibility and the engine-specific weighting differences.
- [Owned, Earned, and Community Sources in AI Answers: A 3-Layer Strategy](https://solcrys.com/owned-earned-community-sources-ai/): AI engines cite three distinct source layers — owned (your site), earned (PR/editorial), and community (Reddit/G2/forums). This guide explains how to balance investment by category and life stage.
- [Reddit, G2, and Forums: How to Win the Community Source Layer for AI Citations](https://solcrys.com/reddit-g2-community-sources-aeo/): AI engines cite Reddit, G2, and niche forums disproportionately when answering buyer prompts. This guide is the practitioner playbook for earning community citations without becoming spam — with the 7 rules of native engagement.
- [How to Earn LLM Citations Without Becoming Spam: The Content-Source Match Framework](https://solcrys.com/earn-llm-citations-content-source-match/): AI engines preferentially cite 5 specific content patterns. This guide breaks down the content-source match framework, the 12 examples of cited content, and the slow-burn strategy that compounds without manipulation.
- [AEO Platform Buyer's Guide 2026: 12 Questions to Ask Every Vendor](https://solcrys.com/ai-visibility-platform-buyers-guide/): A practitioner buyer guide for choosing an AEO/AI visibility platform in 2026. The 12 questions that separate dashboard tools from execution platforms, the red flags to avoid, and a pricing reality check.
- [Generic AEO vs Retail AEO: Why You Probably Need Both](https://solcrys.com/generic-aeo-vs-retail-aeo/): Generic AEO platforms and Retail AEO platforms are different categories with different engines, signals, actions, and tools. This guide breaks down when you need each and when you need both.
- [How to Run a 30-Day AEO Platform Pilot Without Wasting Budget](https://solcrys.com/aeo-platform-pilot-playbook/): A structured 30-day pilot framework for AEO platforms — pre-pilot setup, week-by-week timeline, exit criteria, and the common pilot anti-patterns that produce wrong purchase decisions.
- [How to Optimize for ChatGPT Search: The 2026 Practitioner Guide](https://solcrys.com/optimize-for-chatgpt-search/): ChatGPT Search uses Bing's index, OpenAI's crawlers, and on-demand fetches. This guide breaks down the five ranking signals, the crawler access checklist, and the content patterns that get cited in ChatGPT answers.
- [How to Optimize for Perplexity AI: Citation-First Strategy](https://solcrys.com/optimize-for-perplexity/): Perplexity uses real-time RAG with strong recency and authority weighting. This guide breaks down the four unique signals, the difference between Perplexity Search and Pro Search, and the optimization playbook that does not apply to other AI engines.
- [How to Optimize for Google AI Overviews & AI Mode](https://solcrys.com/optimize-for-google-ai-overviews-ai-mode/): Google AI Overviews and AI Mode use Google's index plus generative synthesis. This guide breaks down the inheritance signals, the difference between AIO and AI Mode, and the optimization playbook that does not require abandoning SEO.
- [How to Optimize for Claude: The Anthropic Web Search Difference](https://solcrys.com/optimize-for-claude/): Claude's web search has its own crawler guidance, citation behavior, and analytical query skew. This guide breaks down practical optimization moves for technical and analytical buyer prompts.
- [How to Optimize for Gemini: Google's Other AI Search Engine](https://solcrys.com/optimize-for-gemini/): Gemini shares Google's index but layers Gemini-specific signals: stronger grounding controls, Workspace integration, and multimodal preference. This guide covers the four differences from Google AI Overviews and the optimization checklist.
- [AI Engine Comparison: ChatGPT vs Perplexity vs Google AI vs Claude vs Gemini](https://solcrys.com/ai-engine-comparison/): How the major AI search engines differ across data sources, ranking signals, citation patterns, and optimization priority. A pillar guide for multi-engine AEO strategy.
- [AEO ROI Business Case](https://solcrys.com/aeo-roi-business-case/): A practitioner framework for estimating and reviewing AEO ROI with finance. Includes the AEO Revenue Model formula, three attribution methods, a 5-slide deck structure, and a 12-month measurement template.
- [AEO Actions to Revenue](https://solcrys.com/aeo-actions-to-revenue/): Visibility metrics are not revenue. This guide is the operational playbook for tracking AEO actions through to conversion events - GA4 limits, survey-based attribution, first-party Recovery scoring, and the multi-touch attribution flow.
- [AEO Recovery Score](https://solcrys.com/aeo-recovery-score/): AEO Recovery Score is a quantified metric measuring how much of an answer gap your fix actions actually closed. This guide defines the formula, measurement windows, and how to set expectations without overclaiming recovery.
- [Reddit AEO Playbook](https://solcrys.com/reddit-aeo-playbook/): A 6-step playbook for earning Reddit citations in AI answers - weekly cadence, thread-authoring patterns, disclosure norms, and a 12-week build plan. Includes guidance for validating when YouTube should be paired with Reddit.
- [Product Q&A Coverage for Retail AEO](https://solcrys.com/q-and-a-coverage-retail-aeo/): Product Q&A is an underused asset in retail AEO. This guide covers compliant Q&A workflows, the 5 buyer-concern Q&A categories, marketplace TOS limits, and a 30-day coverage playbook.
- [Comments as AI Citations](https://solcrys.com/comments-as-ai-citations/): User comments under YouTube videos, blog posts, and Reddit threads can appear in AI-cited sources. This guide explains how to participate ethically in comment-layer conversations and what patterns are useful to buyers.
- [AI Search Is a Decision Layer](https://solcrys.com/ai-search-is-decision-layer/): Treating AI search as 'another channel' alongside SEO and paid undercounts its impact. AI search is a decision layer that influences buyers across all other channels. This essay explains the implication for measurement and investment.
- [Why llms.txt Is Not a Strategy](https://solcrys.com/llms-txt-not-a-strategy/): llms.txt is a proposed standard for AI-friendly content delivery, but it is neither widely adopted by major AI engines nor a substitute for AEO fundamentals. This essay explains what llms.txt does, what it does not, and why brands should focus on the unsexy basics.
- [Golden Prompt Set Methodology](https://solcrys.com/golden-prompt-set-methodology/): How SolCrys grounds AEO tracking on real intent volume, public community questions, AI query signals, and live engine follow-ups - not synthetic keyword lists.
- [AI Visibility Measurement Methodology](https://solcrys.com/visibility-measurement-methodology/): How SolCrys captures AI visibility data: dual-channel measurement that combines consumer-surface capture from ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Rufus with API capture for agents - every data point traceable to a prompt, platform, and timestamp.
- [Evaluate an AEO Platform's Data Methodology](https://solcrys.com/evaluate-aeo-platform-methodology-checklist/): A buyer's checklist for evaluating AEO and AI visibility platforms on data methodology. Seven questions that distinguish vendors with auditable, fidelity-first measurement from vendors with synthetic dashboards.
- [When 'Marketing Agent Infrastructure' Helps or Hurts AEO Buyers](https://solcrys.com/marketing-agent-infrastructure-aeo-positioning/): 'Marketing agent infrastructure' has become a common AEO category claim. This essay explains when the framing helps buyers, when it stays too abstract to be useful, and how SolCrys keeps generic AEO plus retail execution concrete.
